skill: M08 回旋尾扫（妖鳄精英）

parameters.prompt: The exact crocodile in the reference performs ONE tail whip attack in place. It crouches low and curls the thick tail to its side to wind up, then twists its hips and swings the tail low along the ground in one wide arc toward screen left in front of it, the front feet pivoting slightly, then slowly curls the tail back and returns to the exact original pose and holds it. The tail keeps the same length and never leaves the frame. Exactly four legs and one tail. Only one swing, no full spin, no rolling, jumping, biting or moving across the frame. Keep the same view, scales and colours. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with wide margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, breath, fire, smoke, mist, liquid, spray, particles, dust, rocks, cracks, shadow or text.
